title: 第1章 海天
content_zh:
“天哥！天哥！你起来了没啊？大伯叫我们快去集中了！”门外传来一阵稚嫩的吵闹声，让房间里的少年再也无法睡下去了。

睁开双眼望见那并不高的天花板，少年缓缓的坐起身来，脸上并没有流露出少年那天真无邪般的笑容，反而是带有一丝淡淡的苦涩。

“小雨，我知道了，等我一会儿。”少年不咸不淡的答应了一句。

门外的少年也是“哦”了一声便再也没有说话，静静的等待着屋内的少年出来。

屋内的少年抬头望了一眼透过窗户挥洒进来的阳光，闭上了眼睛，不一会儿便睁了开来，低声叹道：“还是不行，难道就真得这样完全消失了吗？”

叹息一声，少年立即穿起衣服走出了门外。

只见门口站立着比他还要小一点的少年，一见屋内的少年出来，立即抱怨道：“天哥，你也真是的，今天可是选择功法的大日子，你怎么这样漫不经心的？”

“功法吗？”那屋内的少年脸上闪过一丝愁容，“小雨，走吧。”紧接着迈步走了出去。

身后那年幼的少年瞪着大眼睛，低声自言自语着：“奇怪，天哥怎么一点都不兴奋呢？今天可是我们能够选择功法的重大日子呀。”

摇了摇脑袋，年幼的少年立即跟了上去：“天哥！等等我！”

被那年幼的少年称呼为天哥的少年，名叫海天，是这黑石城三大家族之一海家家主的二儿子。只是所有人不知道的是，海天其实还有着另外一个身份。

那就是曾经纵横魂剑大陆的无天剑神！

只是因为一些特殊的原因，从大陆上陨落了，并且意外的来到了这个少年的体内。

而那年幼一点的少年，名叫海雨，是海天三叔的儿子，也是他的堂弟。在这个人际关系颇为复杂的大家族中，和他的关系最为要好。

而今天，则是海家一年一度供刚满十岁的子弟进入珍海阁选择修炼功法的日子。他们海家虽然在整个魂剑大陆上排不上号，但是在这黑石城的一亩三分地上，还是有着不错的势力。

收藏自然也是非常的丰富，珍海阁就是他们海家摆放修炼功法的地方。

不一会儿，海天跟小雨两人很快就来到了大厅之中。

此时大厅内已经站了七八个少年，他们看起来全部都和海天小雨差不多大。不过海天却是明白，这些少年都是他的远方亲戚，属于海家的旁系子弟。

见到海天和小雨的到来，坐在首位上的海家家主海无涯眼睛一亮，郎声笑道：“好了，天儿和小雨也已经到了，这回你们十个人就已经全部到齐了。”

说到这里，海无涯顿了顿：“想必你们也都知道今天是你们选择修炼功法的日子。不过有几个问题我要跟你们提前说清楚。首先，等会儿进入珍海阁之后，你们只准进入第一层，不准靠近第二层。如果有违反的，立即驱逐出去，并且没收选择的功法。”

这话一出，顿时那些个旁系子弟们都吓得缩了缩脑袋，他们的父母不属于海家真正的核心阶层，主要是在外面打理生意的。

可想要进入海家的核心阶层，那么就必须拿出一定的实力以及潜力出来，所以这些个旁系子弟们一个比一个认真，没有哪个人敢违反海无涯的话。

满意的望了一眼厅内的众人，海无涯特地在海天和小雨的脸上停了一会，他明白那些旁系子弟是绝对不敢的，他就怕海天跟小雨调皮去硬闯，所以事先打个招呼。

“其次，你们每个人只能选择一本修炼功法，选择了之后，不能带走，只能就地抄录，然后把抄录的带回去。最后我有一点要说的是，如今你们的大哥，海云，短短三年内，已经修炼到了六段剑之力了，相信不出两年就可以成为正式剑者，你们要向他学习。”

海无涯的话音未落，厅内的众人包括小雨在内齐刷刷的将目光望向了海无涯右手边座位上的一个白衣少年。

他就是海天的大哥，海云。如今修炼才三年，就达到了六段剑之力，这在海家年轻一代中修炼速度是最快的。

感受着众人那羡慕外加嫉妒的目光，海云得意的扬了扬眉头，他很享受这种感觉。

只是当他抬起头来，却发现大厅内仅有一人没有看他，反而一直低着头，这让他的心里很是不爽，开口说道：“二弟，你在想什么呢？怎么没听父亲说话？”

那一直低着头没有用嫉妒和羡慕目光望向海云的，正是海天。

听到海云的问话，大厅内的众人“唰”的一下又把目光集中在了海天身上，只是海天仿佛没有听见似的，依然低着头默不作声。

这下海云脸上挂不住了，猛然提高了音量：“二弟！你没听我说话吗？”

小雨见海天还是低着头，悄悄的在背后拉了拉海天，这才让海天回过神来。

“小雨，你干吗拉我？”海天不明的询问了起来。

只是他这话一出，海云的脸色是更加的阴沉了。敢情他刚才说了半天，海天是一句都没有听见。这让身为大哥的他哪还有脸面可言？

还没等他说话，海无涯便率先问道：“天儿，看你的精神状态很不好，是不是生病了？要不要休息一下？”

“不用了，父亲，我没事。”海天淡淡一笑，表示自己并无大碍。

即便如此，海无涯还是颇为担心的摇了摇头：“要不你今天先休息吧，明天再去选择修炼功法吧？”

“这个不太好吧，我还是跟大家一起好了。”海天可不想搞得那么特殊，直接拒绝了。

只是这些对话听在海云的耳里却是相当的刺耳，认为海无涯对海天的关心明显超过了他。望向海天的目光中渐渐的有了一丝憎恨。

“好了，既然大家都准备好了，那么我们便去珍海阁吧。”说着海无涯立即站立了起来，大步走出了大厅。

无论是小雨还是那些旁系子弟们，一个个都是兴奋的跟在后面。

唯独海天却是低着头站在原地，一副漠不关心的样子。

小雨也是发现了海天的异常，急忙走了回来，拉起海天的胳膊叫道：“天哥，你还站在这里做什么？赶快走呀，要不然可就选不到好功法了！”

海天倒也没有反抗，反而是任凭小雨拉着他的胳膊跟着大部队前进。

不一会儿，他们一行人便很快来到了海家的后院一处巨大的建筑物前。这建筑物大约有三层楼高，在正门的上方还挂着一个牌匾，上面写着“珍海阁”几个大字。

“这里就是我们海家置放宝物的地方了。”海无涯用手指着背后的珍海阁对着众人讲解道。要知道这里可是属于海家的禁地，平常是不许别人过来的。

即便是生活在海家总部的海天和小雨，也是第一次来到这里，就更不用说是那些外来的旁系子弟了。

众人一个个都好奇的打量着眼前的建筑物，眼睛都放光，明白他们即将要选择的修炼功法，就在这第一层里面。

见众人那跃跃欲试的样子，海无涯也不再罗嗦，而是直接走向了大门。

右手放在大门上，突然整个大门亮起一片红光，让那些个年轻子弟们一片惊呼。海天也是顺眼抬起了头，望着门上的红光，平静的脸上也多出了一丝惊诧，用蚊子般的声音喃喃自语道：“这是禁制！怎么一个小小的海家也会有这样的禁制存在？”

珍海阁大门上的红光渐渐消失了，海无涯迅速收回了右手，并且转身对众人讲述道：“刚才你们看到的那片红光，是我们海家前辈曾经布置的一种手法。没有正确的方法如果想要贸然闯入，轻则重伤，重则死亡。希望你们要记住。”

众人一听这话，一个个都吓得冷汗直流。特别是小雨，他原本还打算以后来这里玩玩呢，可是海无涯这么说了，他可不想拿自己的小命开玩笑。

“天哥，这个手法好恐怖，居然会有这样的威力。难怪大伯平常不让我们来这里呢，而且也不派人驻守，原来有着这样的防盗方法，真不错呢。”小雨心有余悸的望着那扇大门。

“天哥，天哥，你怎么了？”小雨见海天没有回应，不由得再次叫了两声。

这时海天才是回过神来，摇头笑了笑：“小雨，我没事。好了，大门开了，我们进去吧。”

小雨转头望见海无涯已经推开了大门，那些个旁系子弟们一个个都排队进入，他也是立即拉着海天跑了过去，唯恐被别人甩掉。

只是，当经过那扇大门时，海天的目光却是死死的盯在上面，脑海中一直在思索着。在整个魂剑大陆上，即使是那几个超级豪族也不一定拥有的禁制，可海家却拥有！

“看样子，海家也不是一个普通的小家族嘛？”海天平静的脸上忽然绽放出一抹笑容，大步走了进去。

content_en:
"Brother Tian! Brother Tian! Are you up? The uncle told us to gather quickly!" A childish noise came from outside the door, making it impossible for the young man in the room to sleep anymore.

Opening his eyes and looking at the low ceiling, the young man slowly sat up. His innocent smile did not show on his face, but instead there was a hint of bitterness.

"Xiaoyu, I understand, just wait for me for a while." The young man agreed calmly.

The young man outside the door also said "Oh" and said nothing again, quietly waiting for the young man inside the house to come out.

The young man in the room looked up at the sunlight streaming in through the window, closed his eyes, and opened them after a while, sighing in a low voice: "It still doesn't work. Is it really going to disappear completely like this?"

With a sigh, the young man immediately put on his clothes and walked out of the door.

He saw a younger boy standing at the door. As soon as he saw the boy coming out of the house, he immediately complained: "Brother Tian, it's true, today is a big day for choosing exercises, why are you so careless?"

"Kung Fu?" A trace of sadness flashed across the face of the young man in the room, "Xiaoyu, let's go." Then he walked out.

The young boy behind him stared with big eyes and whispered to himself: "It's strange, why is Brother Tian not excited at all? Today is an important day for us to choose our exercises."

Shaking his head, the young boy immediately followed: "Brother Tian! Wait for me!"

The boy who was called Brother Tian by the young boy was named Hai Tian. He was the second son of the head of the Hai family, one of the three major families in Black Rock City.But what everyone doesn't know is that Haitian actually has another identity.

That was the Wutian Sword God who once dominated the Soul Sword Continent!

Just because of some special reasons, he fell from the mainland and unexpectedly came into this boy's body.

The younger boy, named Hai Yu, is the son of Uncle Hai Tian and his cousin.In this big family with complicated interpersonal relationships, the relationship with him is the best.

Today is the day once a year that the Hai family allows their children who have just turned ten to enter the Zhenhai Pavilion and choose to practice their skills.Although the Hai family is not ranked high in the entire Soul Sword Continent, they still have a good influence in the one-third of an acre of Black Rock City.

The collection is naturally very rich, and Zhenhai Pavilion is where the Hai family displays their cultivation techniques.

After a while, Hai Tian and Xiao Yu quickly arrived in the hall.

At this time, there were seven or eight teenagers standing in the hall. They all looked about the same age as Haitian Xiaoyu.However, Hai Tian understood that these young men were his distant relatives and descendants of the Hai family.

Seeing the arrival of Hai Tian and Xiao Yu, the head of the Hai family, Hai Wuya, who was sitting in the first place, his eyes lit up and he said with a smile, "Okay, Tian'er and Xiao Yu have also arrived. This time, all ten of you are here."

Having said this, Hai Wuya paused: "You must all know that today is the day for you to choose to practice the exercises. However, there are a few issues I want to clarify with you in advance. First of all, after entering Zhenhai Pavilion later, you are only allowed to enter the first floor and are not allowed to approach the second floor. If there is any violation, you will be expelled immediately and the chosen exercises will be confiscated."

As soon as these words came out, the sideline children immediately shrank their heads in fear. Their parents did not belong to the real core class of the Hai family, and mainly took care of business outside.

But if you want to enter the core class of the Hai family, you must show a certain amount of strength and potential. Therefore, each of these collateral disciples is more serious than the other, and no one dares to violate Hai Wuya's words.

Looking at the people in the hall with satisfaction, Hai Wuya paused for a while on the faces of Hai Tian and Xiao Yu. He understood that those subordinate disciples would never dare. He was afraid that Hai Tian and Xiao Yu would naughtyly try to force their way in, so he said hello in advance.

"Secondly, each of you can only choose one practice method. After you choose it, you cannot take it away. You can only copy it on the spot, and then take the copy back. One last thing I want to say is that your eldest brother, Haiyun, has already mastered the power of six levels of swords in just three years. I believe he can become an official swordsman in less than two years. You must learn from him."

Before Hai Wuya finished speaking, everyone in the hall, including Xiao Yu, all looked at the young man in white who was sitting on the right side of Hai Wuya.

He is Hai Tian’s eldest brother, Hai Yun.Now, after only three years of cultivation, he has reached the sixth level of sword power, which is the fastest among the younger generation of the Hai family.

Feeling the envious and jealous eyes of everyone, Haiyun raised his brows proudly. He enjoyed this feeling very much.

But when he raised his head, he found that only one person in the hall did not look at him. Instead, he kept his head lowered. This made him feel very unhappy. He said, "Second brother, what are you thinking about? Why didn't you listen to your father?"

It was Hai Tian who kept his head lowered and did not look at Hai Yun with jealous or envious eyes.

Hearing Hai Yun's question, everyone in the hall suddenly focused their attention on Hai Tian, ​​but Hai Tian didn't seem to hear it and remained silent with his head lowered.

Haiyun couldn't keep his face at this moment and suddenly raised his voice: "Second brother! Didn't you listen to me?"

Seeing that Hai Tian still lowered his head, Xiao Yu quietly pulled Hai Tian from behind, and then Hai Tian came back to his senses.

"Xiao Yu, why are you pulling me?" Hai Tian asked unclearly.

But as soon as he said these words, Haiyun's face became even more gloomy.Fortunately, he just spoke for a long time, but Hai Tian didn't hear a word.How can he, as the eldest brother, have any face at all?

Before he could speak, Hai Wuya took the lead and asked, "Tian'er, I see that your mental state is very bad. Are you sick? Do you want to take a rest?"

"No, father, I'm fine." Hai Tian smiled faintly, indicating that he was fine.

Even so, Hai Wuya still shook his head worriedly: "How about you rest today and choose to practice the exercises tomorrow?"

"This is not good, I'd better go with everyone." Hai Tian didn't want to be so special, so he refused directly.

However, these conversations were quite harsh to Hai Yun's ears, and he thought that Hai Wuya's concern for Hai Tian obviously exceeded that of his.There was gradually a trace of hatred in his eyes looking at Hai Tian.

"Okay, now that everyone is ready, let's go to Zhenhai Pavilion." After saying that, Hai Wuya immediately stood up and strode out of the hall.

Whether it was Xiaoyu or the other disciples, they all followed behind excitedly.

Only Hai Tian stood there with his head lowered, looking indifferent.

Xiao Yu also noticed something unusual about Hai Tian, and hurriedly came back, took Hai Tian's arm and shouted: "Brother Tian, what are you still standing here for? Leave quickly, otherwise you won't be able to choose good exercises!"

Hai Tian did not resist, but let Xiao Yu hold his arm and follow the large army forward.

After a while, the group of them quickly arrived in front of a huge building in the backyard of the Hai family.The building is about three stories high, and there is a plaque hanging above the main entrance with the words "Zhenhai Pavilion" written on it.

"This is where our Hai family keeps our treasures." Hai Wuya pointed at the Zhenhai Pavilion behind him and explained to everyone.You must know that this is a forbidden area belonging to the Hai family, and others are not allowed to come here.

Even Hai Tian and Xiao Yu, who live in the Haijia headquarters, are here for the first time, let alone those external descendants.

Everyone looked at the building in front of them curiously, their eyes shining brightly, and they understood that the practice method they were about to choose was on the first floor.

Seeing everyone's eagerness to try, Hai Wuya stopped talking and walked directly to the gate.

Putting his right hand on the door, suddenly the entire door lit up with a red light, making the young disciples exclaim.Hai Tian also raised his head and looked at the red light on the door. There was a hint of surprise on his calm face, and he murmured to himself in a mosquito-like voice: "This is a restriction! How can a small Hai family have such a restriction?"

The red light on the gate of Zhenhai Pavilion gradually disappeared. Hai Wuya quickly retracted his right hand and turned around to tell everyone: "The red light you saw just now was a technique deployed by our seniors from the Hai family. If you want to rush in without the right method, you will be seriously injured or die. I hope you will remember it."

When everyone heard this, everyone was so frightened that they broke out in cold sweat.Especially Xiaoyu, he originally planned to come here to have fun in the future, but Hai Wuya said so, he didn't want to make fun of his own life.

"Brother Tian, ​​this technique is so terrifying, it can actually have such power. No wonder the uncle usually doesn't let us come here, and he doesn't send anyone to guard it. It turns out that it's really good to have such an anti-theft method." Xiaoyu looked at the door with lingering fear.

"Brother Tian, ​​Brother Tian, ​​what's wrong with you?" Seeing that Hai Tian didn't respond, Xiao Yu couldn't help but call out twice.

At this time, Hai Tian finally came to his senses, shook his head and smiled: "Xiaoyu, I'm fine. Okay, the door is open, let's go in."

Xiao Yu turned around and saw that Hai Wuya had opened the door, and all the disciples from the collateral line were lining up to enter. He immediately pulled Hai Tian and ran over, fearing that he would be thrown away by others.

However, when passing by the gate, Hai Tian's eyes were fixed on it, thinking all the time in his mind.In the entire Soul Sword Continent, even the super wealthy families may not have restrictions, but the Hai family does!

"It seems that the Hai family is not an ordinary small family?" A smile suddenly broke out on Hai Tian's calm face, and he strode in.
